title: B2B E-commerce Data Platform
summary: A simulated B2B e-commerce data platform covering synthetic source generation, incremental ETL orchestration with Dagster, and dbt analytics modeling on DuckDB/MotherDuck. The README explicitly states SDV is not yet implemented in code, and docs/sdv.md only outlines a planned future use of SDV's HMASynthesizer for relational source scaling.
evidence: README: 'This repository does not yet fully implement SDV in code.' docs/sdv.md:36 mentions HMASynthesizer as planned
needs: Confirm whether SDV/HMASynthesizer is ever actually implemented in a later version; currently only planned/documented.
